scene_report.description: Klothys Titan prison V2, revised after visual review: two animated CC0 monster bodies are shallowly embedded as carbonite-like stone reliefs, with thick stone roots blending them into the shell. The front central +/-20 degree vertical slot is intentionally clear for full-height Klothys and her future binding hair; temporary chain geometry has been removed.
design_references: User-approved concept: two full creature silhouettes imprisoned in a cracked runic stone sphere
